description:
Every AI build tool Vibe Shipped tracks (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, Bolt, Replit, v0, Windsurf, Rork, Base44) with official pricing and app stats.
Use when: the user asks which AI build tools exist or what they cost, or you need tool ids for other calls.
Do not use for: a ranking (top_tools), 2-4 side by side (compare_tools), coding-agent harnesses (list_harnesses).
Returns: per tool: what, best_for, pricing (copied from the official page), pricing_url, pricing_checked (date), app count, stated revenue total and median, top apps, new_last_30d.
Limits: No parameters. pricing null means no clear price on the official page; cite pricing_checked.
Example: {}
name: list_tools
title: List AI build tools
